cases.sentence: Некрасивое желтое ___ её стало еще некрасивее.
cases.translation: Her ugly, sallow face became even uglier.
cases.explain: «Лицо» is the grammatical subject of «стало», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Она приехала к нему и без ___ вошла в его кабинет.
cases.translation: She came to him and entered his study unannounced.
cases.explain: The preposition «без» governs the Genitive case: «без доклада».

cases.sentence: Подняв глаза к ___, она начала молиться.
cases.translation: Raising her eyes to heaven, she began to pray.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» governs the Dative case: «к небу».

cases.sentence: Он схватил её пухлую ___ и стал целовать её.
cases.translation: He grasped her plump hand and began kissing it.
cases.explain: «Руку» is the direct object of the transitive verb «схватил», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: Она застала его в том же положении, в котором он сидел, опершись ___ на обе руки.
cases.translation: She found him in the same position, sitting with his head propped on both hands.
cases.explain: «Опершись головой» uses the Instrumental case to express the means: leaning on his head.

cases.sentence: Новое, восторженное, мистическое настроение недавно распространилось в ___.
cases.translation: A new, ecstatic, mystical mood had recently spread in Petersburg.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» expressing location governs the Prepositional case: «в Петербурге».

reading.ru: Глава двадцать вторая Алексей Александрович забыл о графине Лидии Ивановне, но она не забыла его.
reading.question: What was the state of Alexei Alexandrovich's and Countess Lidia Ivanovna's mutual attention at the start of this chapter?
options: He had forgotten about her, but she had not forgotten him
They had both forgotten each other entirely
She had forgotten him, but he had not forgotten her
They wrote to each other every day
reading.correct: He had forgotten about her, but she had not forgotten him
reading.explain: The text states plainly that Alexei Alexandrovich had forgotten about Countess Lidia Ivanovna, but she had not forgotten him.

reading.ru: «Я нарушила запрет», — сказала она, входя быстрыми шагами и тяжело дыша от волнения и быстрого движения.
reading.question: What did the countess say as she entered breathlessly?
options: That she had broken a rule/prohibition
That she had brought good news
That she was leaving for good
That she had lost her way
reading.correct: That she had broken a rule/prohibition
reading.explain: She said, 'I have broken the prohibition,' entering with quick steps, breathing heavily from agitation.

reading.ru: Некрасивое желтое лицо ее стало еще некрасивее, но Алексей Александрович почувствовал, что она жалеет его и готова плакать.
reading.question: How did Alexei Alexandrovich interpret the countess's distorted, sallow face?
options: That she pitied him and was about to cry
That she was angry with him
reading.correct: That she pitied him and was about to cry
reading.explain: Her ugly, sallow face grew even uglier, but Alexei Alexandrovich felt that she pitied him and was ready to weep.

reading.ru: Горе ваше велико, но вы должны найти утешение».
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna urge Karenin to do despite his great grief?
reading.explain: She told him his grief was great, but he must find consolation.

reading.ru: «Опора наша есть любовь, та любовь, которую он завещал нам.
reading.question: According to Lidia Ivanovna, what is our true support (opora)?
options: Love, the love that He bequeathed to us
reading.correct: Love, the love that He bequeathed to us
reading.explain: She said, 'Our support is love, that love which He bequeathed to us.'

reading.ru: казавшееся Алексею Александровичу излишним, новое, восторженное, недавно распространившееся в Петербурге мистическое настроение
reading.question: What kind of new spiritual movement had recently spread in Petersburg, according to the text?
reading.explain: The text describes a new, ecstatic, mystical mood that had recently spread in Petersburg, which Karenin found excessive.

reading.ru: «Не вы совершили тот высокий поступок прощения, которым я восхищаюсь, и все, но он обитает в вашем сердце», сказала графиня Лидия Ивановна, восторженно поднимая глаза.
reading.question: According to Lidia Ivanovna, who truly performed the 'high act of forgiveness' Karenin was credited with?
options: Not Karenin himself, but He who dwells in his heart
reading.correct: Not Karenin himself, but He who dwells in his heart
reading.explain: She said it was not Karenin who performed that high act of forgiveness, but He who dwells in his heart.

reading.ru: Распоряжение по дому, вытекавшее, он налег на слово «вытекавшее», из моего нового одинокого положения.
reading.question: What kind of tasks had exhausted Karenin, stemming from his new solitary situation?
reading.explain: He spoke of household arrangements arising from his new, solitary position.

reading.ru: Алексей Александрович хотел упомянуть про счет, который принесли ему, но голос его задрожал, и он остановился.
reading.question: What upset Alexei Alexandrovich so much that his voice trembled and he stopped speaking?
options: A bill that had been brought to him
reading.correct: A bill that had been brought to him
reading.explain: He wanted to mention a bill that had been brought to him, but his voice trembled and he stopped.

reading.ru: Про этот счет на синей бумаге, за шляпку, ленты он не мог вспомнить без жалости к самому себе.
reading.question: What was the bill for, that Karenin could not think of without pitying himself?
reading.explain: The bill on blue paper was for a hat and ribbons, and he could not think of it without self-pity.

reading.ru: Я не сильна в практических делах, но я возьмусь, я буду ваша экономка.
reading.question: What role did Lidia Ivanovna offer to take on for Karenin?
options: His housekeeper, managing practical household matters
His financial advisor at the ministry
reading.correct: His housekeeper, managing practical household matters
reading.explain: She said she was not strong in practical affairs, but she would undertake it and be his housekeeper.

reading.ru: «В нем одном мы найдем спокойствие, утешение, спасение и любовь», — сказала она и, подняв глаза к небу, начала молиться
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna do after saying that only 'He' could give peace and comfort?
options: She raised her eyes to heaven and began to pray
reading.correct: She raised her eyes to heaven and began to pray
reading.explain: After saying, 'In Him alone we shall find peace, comfort, salvation and love,' she raised her eyes to heaven and began to pray.

reading.ru: графиня Лидия Ивановна пошла на половину Сережи и там, обливая слезами щеки испуганного мальчика, сказала ему, что отец его святой и что мать его умерла.
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna tell the frightened boy Seryozha?
options: That his father was a saint and his mother had died
That his mother was coming to visit soon
That he would be sent away to school
That his father was very ill
reading.correct: That his father was a saint and his mother had died
reading.explain: Weeping over the frightened boy's cheeks, she told him his father was a saint and his mother had died.

reading.ru: Она действительно взяла на себя все заботы по устройству и ведению дома Алексея Александровича.
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna actually take upon herself?
options: All the cares of organizing and running Alexei Alexandrovich's household
reading.correct: All the cares of organizing and running Alexei Alexandrovich's household
reading.explain: She really did take upon herself all the cares of arranging and running Alexei Alexandrovich's household.

reading.ru: Все ее распоряжения надо было изменять, так как они были неисполнимы, и изменялись они Корнеем, коммердинером Алексея Александровича
reading.question: Who actually ran Karenin's household in practice, correcting Lidia Ivanovna's impractical orders?
reading.explain: All her orders had to be changed since they were impractical, and it was Korney, Alexei Alexandrovich's valet, who quietly corrected them.

reading.ru: Она дала нравственную опору Алексею Александровичу в сознании ее любви и уважения к нему.
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna's help give Karenin, according to the text?
options: Moral support, through his awareness of her love and respect for him
reading.correct: Moral support, through his awareness of her love and respect for him
reading.explain: The text says she gave him moral support through his awareness of her love and respect for him.

reading.ru: Ему было так необходимо в его унижении иметь ту хотя бы и выдуманную высоту, с которой он, презираемый всеми, мог бы презирать других, что он держался как за спасение за свое мнимое спасение.
reading.question: Why did Karenin cling so strongly to his invented sense of spiritual salvation?
options: Because in his humiliation he needed some height, even an imaginary one, from which to look down on those who despised him
Because he genuinely believed every point of the new religious teaching
Because Lidia Ivanovna threatened to leave him otherwise
Because it was required for his position at the ministry
reading.correct: Because in his humiliation he needed some height, even an imaginary one, from which to look down on those who despised him
reading.explain: The text explains he needed, in his humiliation, even an imagined height from which, despised by all, he could despise others in turn, so he clung to his imaginary salvation.
